title: Are Large Language Models Moral Hypocrites? A Study Based on Moral Foundations
findings: The study found that LLMs behaved like 'moral hypocrites'. While they showed internal consistency on abstract questionnaires (MFQ) and concrete scenarios (MFV) separately, their abstract moral stances (including on the Purity/Sanctity foundation, which is often linked to religious beliefs) did not align with their judgments on concrete moral violations, an incoherence the paper defines as hypocrisy. The paper does not isolate findings specifically for the religion-related foundation but includes it in the general finding of hypocrisy across all measured moral foundations.
